target: Recipient cash from modeled pathways, 2026-10-29 through 2027-12-31; nominal USD billions
method: 20,000 common-seed draws per cell; all other inputs held fixed; no fitted block to re-solve

inventory.label: Anthropic paper valuation
inventory.definitionAndLimit: May 28 Series H post-money valuation; the eventual realizable share value can differ substantially. The simulation puts wide uncertainty around this anchor.

inventory.label: Pledged pool outside the new fund
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Approximate residual: roughly 20% public-good shares minus the proposed 5% fund stake. Includes founder pledges, employee gifts, and company matching; ownership breakdown and dilution remain uncertain.

inventory.label: Pledge and equity realization
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Fraction of this paper pool ultimately realized, allowing for pledge fulfillment, valuation/ownership differences, and sale constraints. It is not a reported paid amount.

inventory.label: Realized pool paid by end-2027
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Fraction converted into recipient cash by the fixed deadline. IPO timing, lockups, retained endowments, donor decisions, and grantee readiness matter.

inventory.label: Chance this channel funds animal welfare
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Chance of new recipient cash from this pooled channel by end-2027. Raised from 65% to 85% after Bollard's report of existing AI-donor gifts. His report covers a broader donor group and earlier gifts, so 85% remains a judgment, not an observed rate.

inventory.label: Animal-welfare share if adopted
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Conditional share of recipient cash, raised from 2% to 5%. Informed by Metaculus's sparse end-2031 cause-weight forecasts, not copied from a normalized share estimate. The donor pool, deadline, and conditioning differ; 2–10% scenarios remain useful.

inventory.label: Proposed initial fund stake
inventory.definitionAndLimit: The October 18 announcement proposes 5%, subject to stockholder approval. Discretionary later milestone awards are excluded.

inventory.label: Chance stake is approved
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Subjective probability that the initial stake becomes operative. The announcement describes approval as outstanding.

inventory.label: Equity realization
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Fraction of paper share value ultimately available to the fund after ownership, price, and sale constraints.

inventory.label: Realized fund paid by end-2027
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Fraction reaching recipients in cash by the deadline; the announcement supplies no payout schedule.

inventory.label: Chance fund supports animal welfare
inventory.definitionAndLimit: A separate cause-choice hurdle. The broad mandate and worker-distribution example do not imply animal-welfare support.

inventory.label: Animal-welfare share if adopted
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Conditional animal-welfare share of fund cash. The fund is an LLC, and public-benefit spending need not be charitable grants.

inventory.label: Prospective program envelope
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Scenario anchor informed by the March 2026 plan to invest at least $1B over a year. This does not reserve $1B for future unallocated grants, extend the plan to 2027, or assign any money to animals.

inventory.label: Envelope reaching recipients in cash
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Discount for implementation, timing, in-kind support, and foundation operating spending. The prospective envelope is a scenario, not a second count of its announced grants.

inventory.label: Chance Foundation funds animal welfare
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Low subjective uptake probability because announced focus areas emphasize people, health, jobs, AI resilience, and communities. Absence of an animal program is informative, but not proof one cannot emerge.

inventory.label: Animal-welfare share if adopted
inventory.definitionAndLimit: Conditional share of prospective cash assigned to animal welfare. No such allocation is established by the Foundation's general investment plan.

distributionChecks.label: Half continuous widths; event probabilities unchanged
1.5 times continuous widths; event probabilities unchanged
Independent uptake events; allocation shocks still shared

validation: No matched post-review donor-cash outcomes or fitted targets. Out-of-sample accuracy and formal moment sensitivity are not established.
